title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Resistant Organism Any Property

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Resistant organisms and resistance mechanisms: Resistant organism — any observable about a resistant organism (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Every observable whose Component or Inheres in is an antimicrobial resistant organism, any property (identity, threshold, counts, type). Parts: LOINC enumeration (16, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : (246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 409793007 |Antimicrobial resistant bacteria (organism)| OR 704319004 |Inheres in (attribute)| = << 409793007 |Antimicrobial resistant bacteria (organism)|)`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
